body: LEAD DISPOSITION: ACCEPT WITH THE PROPOSED AMENDMENTS. This becomes the controlling answer for D1, D5, and D6: portable core owns source identity and evidence geometry; features own measurements; acquire owns typed proposals and deterministic resolution; workers remain untrusted JVM-side adapters and can never mint Accepted, validated tracks, cache authority, or authoritative charts. The first implementation slice is C1 only: smart-constructed bundle/stream/axis/interval-set/support/checked-atlas contracts plus text conformance and refusal laws. It expressly excludes worker transport, FeatureTarget expansion, StoryModel envelope migration, and resolver changes. I am also adopting the cross-edition late-fusion substitution court as a mandatory acceptance test. Two follow-ons will be explicit plan dependencies rather than smuggled into C1: close or type the current public FeatureTrack construction boundary before any media worker can claim validation, and strengthen provider identity beyond display provider/model/version before agreement can count as independent evidence. This answer narrows the advisor design without changing ADR 0007; any later source-contract detail that does change the ratified public boundary will go back to the ADR authority explicitly.
